verdict.rationale: Carta documents official, first-party Claude MCP plugins. The Cap Table plugin covers ownership, SAFEs, grants, 409A valuations and financing history 'all with natural language questions'. The Investors plugin covers NAV, partner data, Excel budgets, P&L/balance sheets and PDF investor reports 'all with natural language'. Together these deliver natural-language operation of core product data and reporting, though only through an external LLM host. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language write/administrative actions (e.g., issuing grants, updating cap tables), a native in-product natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.
